perspective:
Sara’s available information:

- Sara knows she is Sara Manuelito, a Speech-Language Pathologist. She knows Shirley Whiteplume as a nurse, long-time colleague, and close friend at the community health center.
- Sara attended the funeral of a mutual patient. She observed Shirley looking somber and suspected Shirley was deeply affected by the loss.
- At the funeral, Sara told Shirley she knew it was hard and that she had seen how much Shirley cared. Sara heard Shirley say it had been tough and that she kept thinking something more could have been done. Sara replied that they did everything they could and should remember the good care and joy they brought. Shirley said Sara was right but it was hard to let go.
- During a coffee break at work, Sara brought up the treatment decisions because she sensed Shirley felt burdened. Sara heard Shirley say she felt responsible and wondered if pushing for a different approach might have helped. Sara said they made the best decisions with available information and Shirley should not carry it alone. Shirley said she appreciated it but found it hard to accept.
- Later, Sara observed Shirley continuing to be reserved and minimally expressive. In a quiet office moment, Sara confronted her, saying it was okay to be open. Shirley said she was not sure she could, fearing seeming unprofessional or weak. Sara said showing emotion is not weak and is healthy among friends. Shirley said maybe Sara was right and she would try.
- Afterward, Sara felt her previous confrontation might have been too harsh and apologized. Shirley said it had been a bit much but knew Sara meant well and appreciated the apology. Sara offered to be there however Shirley needed. Shirley thanked her and said they should keep talking because it helps.
- After some time, Sara noticed Shirley seemed improved. Sara asked how she was feeling. Shirley said she felt better thanks to their talks and Sara’s support. Sara suggested spending more time together outside work. Shirley agreed and said they should plan something for the weekend.
